content: This significant financial growth underscores the immense potential within the sector and highlights the critical need for competitive intelligence as providers vie for market share. The persistent issue of illegal mining, particularly associated with gold and platinum group metals, has historically contributed to severe financial losses for companies and has precipitated critical safety incidents in both abandoned and operational mines. Organized criminal syndicates have been reported to operate with increasing sophistication within this sector, aggressively exploiting vulnerabilities in both physical and digital infrastructures [21][6][23] . Additionally, labor unrest and community protests situated near mining zones have frequently escalated security concerns, resulting in operational disruptions and heightened tensions among stakeholders . South Africa’s integration into global financial networks necessitates strict adherence to anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing (AML/CFT) systems.
